description: Get the listing for one iOS app by app_id: name, developer, subtitle, description, version, price, languages, content rating, screenshot URLs, an AI-written short summary, plus the storefront's rating and rating count, its latest recorded chart position (and the one before it), and the latest revenue and downloads estimate. Use this for a single app's current snapshot; use get_ranking_history for positions over time, get_revenue_history for estimates over time and get_timeline for listing changes. Errors with 'App not found' when the id is not in our data. Get the id from search_apps. For several apps (a chart, a competitor list) pass app_ids instead of calling once per app.

app_id.description: App Store ID (numeric ID from the app URL)

app_ids.description: Up to 25 App Store IDs in one call instead of app_id, e.g. every app of a get_rankings chart. Answers { items: [{ app_id, data } or { app_id, error }] }. Each app counts as one call against the monthly limit.

name: get_app_details
title: Get app details
